svg.aria-label: Projects: AI Feedback System: Users get an AI reply to their review; admins get summaries and suggested actions. Shared Object: Co-built at an AI Tinkerers hackathon: an agent that flags when two Slack threads decide opposite things. Parchi: A macOS app for notes, to-dos and photos that stay on your desktop. No account. Network Intrusion Detection: XGBoost on 2.8M network flows, served with FastAPI, Prometheus metrics and drift detection. Waste Watch Campus: Campus waste reports where Gemini classifies waste type and severity from photos.
